args.title: Corvid Packaging — "Warehouse automation in 2026" (article + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary (3 bullets):

• Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, per Corvid Packaging's "Warehouse automation in 2026" article (https://blog.corvid.example/2026/warehouse).
• Integration took twice as long as planned — a significant caveat on the headline throughput gain.
• Companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/warehouse/companion): the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Note: companion piece was accessed via its registration link using rafael.sato@northwind.example.
